The erased borrowed base operations are supplied by genuine shared SfxStyleSheet values;this neither implements nor substitutes ScStyleSheet,ScStyleSheetPool,ScPoolHelper,document style resolution or standard-style construction. No browser style store or broad native UI/device/UNO/ABI parity is claimed.
